correctness.rationale: Every step is proved for arbitrary odd prime power q. The induced μ_h permutation forces r odd and B^D=1; a Frobenius sign argument forces B∈F_q; even-sized cosets cancel block and power signs, and the paired μ_h roots make the remaining coefficient contribution χ_q(B²)=1. Exact direct finite-field tests for q=3,5,7,11,9 cover 16,064 parameter evaluations and all 2,132 permutations agree. Computation is corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: An exact permutation-sign invariant across all admissible nonzero coefficients and all gcd-two index parameters for odd quadratic finite-field extensions provides a natural structural parity classification beyond the existence theorem. It detects a sharp r mod 4 switch and an unexpectedly complete cancellation of coefficient effects, contrasting with the adjacent index-one case where the sign varies with norms. It does not claim arbitrary-index or cycle-type classification.
